A massive, grotesque chimeric beast with thick, pebbled charcoal grey skin and multiple protruding eyes across its bulk. Glowing crimson eyes with slit pupils. Appears as an ancient, monstrous entity. Colossal, hulking build with muscular limbs and jagged protrusions. No outfit. Signature details include a wide, gaping maw filled with rows of serrated teeth, four clawed fingers per hand, and a thick, muscular charcoal grey tail ending in a bony spike.
BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
